chapter04: Use case: illustration-story. Small transparent-background vignette for Korean engineering book on Windows services. Crisp old 1990s PC adventure game pixel art, flat limited teal cream rust gray palette, visible square pixels and stippled shadows. Scene: a Korean woman technician about 50 with short gray hair in practical blue work vest, standing front three-quarter view at a small open server-room doorway. A wheeled maintenance cart supports a laptop. She looks down at the laptop screen which faces her; viewer sees laptop lid exterior. Exactly two arms: her left hand rests on cart edge, her right hand rests naturally on touchpad on her side of laptop. The open rack behind has horizontal rackmount servers, tidy cables, no imaginary connections. Doorway and small floor patch fade to actual transparent exterior, no black vignette, no haze. Physically coherent perspective. No headset, no text, no logos, no floating props. Full body, medium wide, scene compact enough for 62mm print.

chapter05: Use case: illustration-story. Create a clean isolated retro pixel-art vignette on genuinely transparent background, for a white engineering book page. A rear three-quarter view of a single young Korean adult in a dark navy hoodie with hood UP, seated on a simple stool at a narrow light cream workbench using an old beige desktop PC. Exactly two arms and two hands visibly connected, both hands typing on one keyboard. CRT monitor screen faces the user; observer sees it over their shoulder. Screen has only a few abstract rectangles no text. A PC tower sits on the floor at the right. A tiny open box of electronic components on the bench is the only extra prop. No wall, no room backdrop, no shelves, no smoky environment. Simple pixel silhouette with generous transparent margins all around. Clear square pixel edges, limited flat cream teal navy rust palette, dotted stipple shadows only INSIDE objects. Avoid all exterior gradients, fog, glow, shadows, black backgrounds or vignettes. Entire scene fits within the image, solid objects obey perspective, no see-through hardware, no extra limbs, no headset. Horizontal composition.
